WITH market_operational_stability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.mktregistry, 
        t1.mktdenom, 
        t1.mktclass, 
        -- Calculate Operational Security Index (OSI)
        (
            (t2.APL * 0.5) + 
            (t2.SPS * 0.2) + 
            (t2.tornodecount * 2) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Standard' THEN 1 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Custom' THEN 3 
                    ELSE 0
                END * 5
            ) - 
            (t2.iptally * 0.5)
        ) AS operational_stability_score,
        -- Calculate Market Risk Score (MRS)
        (
            (t1.dlyflow / 1000) + 
            (t1.esccomprate * 0.2) + 
            (t1.interscore * 0.3) + 
            (t1.vendcount * 0.1) - 
            (t1.mktspan / 100)
        ) AS market_risk_score,
        -- Extract fields from market_status_reputation JSONB column
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'status')::text AS status,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'trust_level')::text AS trust_level,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'reputation_score')::numeric AS reputation_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'community_trust_score')::numeric AS community_trust_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'dispute_resolution_score')::numeric AS dispute_resolution_score,
        -- Set compliance metrics to zero disputes
        jsonb_build_object(
            'rule_break_count', 0,
            'warning_count', 0,
            'penalty_count', 0,
            'restriction_level', 'None'
        ) AS compliance_metrics
    FROM 
        markets AS t1
    JOIN 
        (
            SELECT 
                secmonregistry, 
                -- Calculate Anonymity Protection Level (APL)
                (
                    (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + 
                    (tornodecount * 2) + 
                    (encryptmethod_numeric * 15) + 
                    (connpatscore * 0.2) + 
                    (brwsrunique / 20)
                ) AS APL,
                -- Calculate Security Posture Score (SPS)
                (
                    (100 - (vulntally * 5)) + 
                    (securitymeasurecount * 2) + 
                    (sessionsecurityscore * 0.5) + 
                    (privprotscore * 0.3) - 
                    (fpprob * 100)
                ) AS SPS,
                iptally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag_numeric, brwsrunique, connpatscore,
                vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore, privprotscore, fpprob
            FROM 
                (
                    SELECT 
                        secmonregistry, iptally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag,
                        brwsrunique, connpatscore, vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore,
                        privprotscore, fpprob,
                        -- Map vpnflag to numeric values
                        CASE vpnflag 
                            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS vpnflag_numeric,
                        -- Map encryptmethod to numeric values
                        CASE encryptmethod 
                            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                            WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS encryptmethod_numeric
                    FROM 
                        securitymonitoring
                ) AS t2
        ) AS t2
    ON 
        t1.mktregistry = t2.secmonregistry
),
ranked_markets AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry, 
        mktdenom, 
        mktclass, 
        operational_stability_score, 
        market_risk_score, 
        status, 
        trust_level, 
        reputation_score, 
        community_trust_score, 
        dispute_resolution_score,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY 
                operational_stability_score DESC
        ) AS stability_rank
    FROM 
        market_operational_stability
)
SELECT 
    mktdenom, 
    mktclass, 
    operational_stability_score, 
    market_risk_score, 
    status, 
    trust_level, 
    reputation_score, 
    community_trust_score, 
    dispute_resolution_score, 
    stability_rank
FROM 
    ranked_markets
ORDER BY 
    stability_rank;
